reviewer: Codex session — visual artifact inspection, not retrospective owner judgment
basis: Four most recent available explicitly approved/locked masters by decision-entry time; publication is not inferred.

works.scope: Actual retained rendered contact sheet/local montage visually inspected in this session; sampled outputs, not continuous playback or mobile testing.
findings: Warm pale/cream field dominates the sampled opening, proof and payoff; dark green text and vermilion annotations.
Centered paper/diagram stage, generous margins, small upper hierarchy and large lower plain captions. Flat authored SVG/CSS; no camera travel, paper turns/scales in place.
Cut-turn hook resolves with the original/half overlay. Paper material gives a clear independent story reason for a light treatment.
Similar feed-level light/minimal demonstration impression to Longitude despite different fonts, geometry and subject.

works.scope: Actual retained rendered contact sheet/local montage visually inspected in this session; sampled outputs, not continuous playback or mobile testing.
findings: Light smoky lilac field with cocoa object and pale tan/lilac analytical insets; not literally cream throughout.
Centered oblique dimensional chocolate specimen switches to planar material diagrams. High dark-text contrast, upper headings, lower plain captions, generous margins.
Same-recipe contrasting bars open; material/network contrast returns to the intact object in payoff. Different object/medium treatment and humanist typography from Longitude.
Light environmental tone and information hierarchy can feel related to Longitude/Paper in a feed even with different colors/materials. Local guide rectangles are QA overlays, not native platform UI.

works.scope: Actual retained rendered contact sheet/local montage visually inspected in this session; sampled outputs, not continuous playback or mobile testing.
findings: Cream/ivory museum-workbench field persists across sampled hook, clock/solar-angle proof and concluding mechanism.
Centered shallow object theatre and planar diagrams; generous space, small upper label, serif story heading, lower dark caption phrases.
Stable objects and restrained state changes, rather than a traveling camera; carried clock opens, time-to-location explanatory relationship resolves payoff.
Similar light demonstration-stage feed impression to Paper, with story-specific navigational props, serif type and relief/shadow differences.

works.scope: Actual retained rendered contact sheet/local montage visually inspected in this session; sampled outputs, not continuous playback or mobile testing.
findings: Dark blue/green environment, illuminated vehicles/road, green/gold signal accents and light designed captions.
Straight-road/ring-to-unwrapped layouts and repeated object trajectories show a backward-moving wave; environment has texture/depth.
Road hook and backward-wave payoff use spatial flow; feed impression is more atmospheric and dark than the three newer treatments.

Shares disciplined hierarchy and centered causal illustration, while differing substantially in environmental tone, density and motion language. No first-class CreativeDirection existed for this approved historical master.

assessment: Owner observation supported at overall light/minimal explanatory-stage impression. Differences in hue, material, typography, hook and mechanisms remain meaningful. Similarity is not failure.
rootCause: Not determinable as artistic causality. Existing comparisons acknowledge story-specific differences but can overlook shared feed impression; schema only required generic asset-based rationale and an empty unresolved-convenience list. No evidence that tooling actually caused the approved choices.
